name: v0.3.0
known_limitations: No binary ABI compatibility is promised before version 1.0.
The stable compatibility promise covers GameNet::core source contracts; upper-layer targets remain provisional.
Shared libraries, TLS, HTTP, RPC, UDP, KCP, macOS, and BSD platforms are not supported in v0.3.0.
The io_uring IOE-X1-X10 path is experimental, Linux-only, and excluded from installed release packages.
